description: This PHP script handles downloading attachments for the TestLink open-source test management tool. It authenticates requests, verifies attachment access permissions, fetches attachment content from the database or filesystem, and serves it with appropriate HTTP headers. It also includes security measures to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks in SVG files.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments needed for attachment download, parsing input parameters and determining the operation mode (API or GUI).

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to access attachments based on configuration settings.
